designationHistory.indexText: Chase Lake National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1908 under President Theodore Roosevelt as a reserve and breeding ground for native birds, making it the 15th refuge established in the country.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
